notes: Phase 2, zero new real data. World: worlds/drone/site_world.py mechanisms refitted on all five code_wm lives (fit_all.json; no mission-B data exists). Changes vs phase 1: (1) route mode start -> R1 -> aisle entry (R2.x, 0) -> R2 (inside the north aisle) -> aisle exit (R2.x, 0.5) -> R3, since the straight R1-R2 line cuts the wall; (2) fix of the missed-relay deadlock (first noticed on mission-A evaluation seed 1038; reproduced in the code world first: 46/4096 imagined timeouts, all stuck after missing relay 2 at x 33.6-34.8; 0/4096 with the fix): past a relay it has not reached, the controller flies straight back to it, and route segments ending at a relay advance only when the relay index confirms it was reached; (3) the jet inside the north aisle is an extrapolation (lives reached only y ~3.1 of the aisle; the relay is at y ~6), so synthesis randomised its depth gain JET_N_GY uniformly in [-0.2, 0.1] (0.6x-1.8x the mouth strength at the relay) and allowed tilt up to 1.4 rad. Gains by cross-entropy search (6.89M wm steps, 19.5 s); selection among the last two candidates by an extra code-world stress test (8 scenarios x 4 variants x 1024 imagined lives, steps not counted). Code-world prediction for the chosen controller: 99.6% success, 10.8 s (2048 randomised lives).
